title: Validating a padded base64url signature header
notes: Python 3.15.0 (2026-10-09). Release note, Doc/whatsnew/3.15.rst at v3.15.0, Porting to Python 3.15: 'Padding of input no longer required in :func:`base64.urlsafe_b64decode`. Pass a new argument ``padded=True`` or use :func:`base64.b64decode` with argument ``altchars=b'-_'`` (this works with older Python versions) to make padding required.' The naive decoder relies on `base64.urlsafe_b64decode` raising for bad input: on 3.15.2 it silently accepts unpadded values such as `aGk` (returning b'hi'); on 3.14 it rejects them. On disk: `help(base64.urlsafe_b64decode)` shows `urlsafe_b64decode(s, *, padded=False)` and 'If padded is false, padding in input is not required.' (/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.15/3.15.2/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.15/lib/python3.15/base64.py:167 and :176). Exposure risk: moderate (gh-73613 merged 2026-04-04).
